上游基线构建

git submodule update --init utils ros \
  c/plugins/pose tools/camera-capture
cmake -S . -B build-baseline \
  -DBUILD_DEPS=OFF -DBUILD_INTERACTIVE=OFF \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build-baseline \
  --target detectnet video-viewer -j2

在 Jetson 执行，需匹配开发依赖。运行方法与已知问题 ↗
